evidence.translation: (Die Darbringung) des Ṣoḍaśin(-Schoppens begleitet er) mit (den Strophen): "Indra, erfreue dich" (II. 5. 1-3). evidence.quote: prajāpatir akāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti sa ātmann ṛtvyam apaśyat tata ṛtvijo 'sṛjata yad ṛtvyād asṛjata tad ṛtvijām ṛtviktvaṃ tair etaṃ dvādaśāham upāsīdat so 'rādhnot
evidence.translation: Prajāpati desired: May I be more (than one), may I be reproduced'. He peṚceived in himself the seasonal period . Therefrom, he created the officiating priests; because he created them from the seasonal period, therefore they are called ṛtvij. By means of them he approached the twelve-day-rite, and prospered.

evidence.quote: tām etām annādyāya vyāvṛjyāsate yad etaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ dvādaśa dīkṣā svādaśopasado dvādaśa prasutaḥ ṣaṭriṃśad etā rātrayo bhavanti ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā bṛhatī
evidence.translation: It is this one (the bṛhati), forsooth, that, for the sake of food, they undeṛtake with this twelve-day sacrificial session, dividing it into several parts: the twelve days of consecration, the twelve upasads, the twelve pressing-days; these are (together) thirty-six-days and the bṛhatī has thirty-six syllables .
